paper.title_en: Parametric Neural Quantum States for Nuclear Physics
paper.abstract_en: We introduce a new approach, based on neural quantum states (NQSs), to rapidly compute nuclear observables when couplings in nuclear Hamiltonians are varied. A single interaction-dependent NQS, trained across a range of couplings in the Hamiltonian, provides high-fidelity wavefunctions for that continuous range of interaction parameters. With access to the wavefunction for each set of couplings, any static observables can be computed efficiently without retraining the NQS. We apply this framework to two-body nuclear scattering and the deuteron ground state with local interactions derived from chiral effective field theory up to third order.
